items.title: Greg Abel Nearly Doubled Berkshire’s Lennar Stake and Added a $689 Million IPO Position
items.summary: Berkshire's first big moves under Greg Abel include a surprise bet on a slumping homebuilder, a fresh IPO and trims to two bank holdings. The filing shows what changed, but the real question is what Abel saw that the market missed.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Is Up 14% in 2026 While the NASDAQ 100 Has Gone Nowhere. Is It Time to Dump Tech Stocks and Buy Berkshire?
items.summary: Tech's brutal November sell-off has investors eyeing the exits, and Warren Buffett's old-school conglomerate looks like the obvious lifeboat. But Berkshire's own recent moves, and one big historical weakness, complicate the idea of swapping everything.

items.title: Warren Buffett’s 3 Biggest Investing Lessons for Anyone Retiring in 2027
items.summary: Buffett left his wife a simple 90/10 portfolio, but he never meant it as a paycheck plan. Skip one overlooked check before you retire, and a single bad first year could drain savings you can never rebuild.

items.title: Exclusive: Twenty One CEO on Bitcoin, acquisitions, and building value
items.summary: Investing.com -- Twenty One Capital is in an unusual position. One of the world’s largest corporate Bitcoin holders wants to reinvent itself as a cash-generating investment company inspired by Berkshire Hathaway, while keeping Bitcoin at the heart of its balance sheet.
